questionText: The primary objective of project crashing is to
optionB: Reduce project duration at minimum additional cost
explanation: Project crashing reduces the project duration by allocating additional resources to selected activities while minimizing the additional cost.
subject: Civil Engineering

questionText: The cost slope of an activity is defined as
optionA: (Normal cost - Crash cost)/(Normal time - Crash time)
optionB: (Crash cost - Normal cost)/(Normal time - Crash time)
optionC: (Crash time - Normal time)/(Crash cost - Normal cost)
explanation: Cost slope = (Crash Cost - Normal Cost)/(Normal Time - Crash Time). It represents the additional cost required to reduce the activity duration by one unit.
subject: Civil Engineering

explanation: Total float = Latest Start - Earliest Start = 7 - 4 = 3 days.

questionText: The purpose of a Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) is to
optionB: Break a project into manageable components
explanation: A WBS divides the total project scope into smaller, manageable work packages and activities.
subject: Civil Engineering

questionText: Resource leveling in construction management is mainly performed to
optionA: Increase the number of critical activities
explanation: Resource leveling adjusts activity schedules to reduce peaks and fluctuations in the demand for resources.

questionText: An activity has a total float of zero. This means that
optionA: The activity can be delayed without affecting the project
